name: notice-board-blocks-v1
description: 18/09/2026, Dean's question: make the Notice Board threshold EXACTLY 3 instead of 3+, so a board with three cards on it REFUSES further plays until its owner harvests. The board becomes an ordinary clogging building again and an owner can switch their own board off by declining to harvest it. rules.economy.noticeBoardThreshold stays 3; only noticeBoardBlocks flips. WHAT IT REVERSES: S8 (10/09/2026) ruled the plus sign IS the rule - 'a minimum to harvest at, never a maximum load, nothing ever blocks, and no owner can shut a board by declining to harvest'. This arm is that ruling undone, so read it as a reversal and not a tweak. DEAN'S HYPOTHESIS: it nerfs the most-visited board powers, Orchard's Draw 4 above all. READ FIRST: turns with a visit (a17, currently FAILING high at 61.2% pooled and 65.4% at four players), then the door mix (a07, also failing), then the crop win rates, then a20 board stall and a04 door clog - a04 has NO SUBJECT under 3+ and comes back to life here, so expect it to start reporting a real number. WATCH: the hook (a08) is the thing this can cost. Every blocked board is a target removed, and the 11/09/2026 record says a starved bonus slot at two players is this design's failure shape. Also watch clog-as-denial (a05): turns beginning with cards and no legal visit is exactly what a blocking board manufactures.
